ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent to any of its affiliates or to any successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added our standard assignment provision: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger or sale of assets without consent and without giving HDI any termination or re-pricing right, while HDI's assignment requires our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may never be to a competitor. As drafted, Section 10.3 only binds successors and assigns and leaves HDI free to transfer our site development and hosting relationship to anyone, including a competitor; if helpful we can instead accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.
input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment right for the Company, no HDI right on our change of control, and a consent/no-competitor gate on HDI assignment.
